name: Replaced components not derecognised -> double-counted carrying amount
rationale: Capitalising a replacement without derecognising the replaced part counts the same economic capacity twice. The rule directs the auditor to trace replacement work orders to derecognition entries, to test componentisation, and to corroborate the work through observation.
source_reference: Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
